question: After all three controlled K=1 operators pass sealed SF3.A2, can they be materialized on the identical confirmation digital sources as exact unclipped RGB16 outputs for severe-first and blind stock-distinguishability review without rereading any film target?
forbidden: film target decode or score during rendering
operator refit, strength adjustment or post-result rescue
AO6 use for Portra 400 or Ektar 100
hard clipping, gamut compression or posthoc limiting
image-adaptive LUT, retrieval or latent K greater than 1
product or calibrated-stock publication before severe and blind gates
claim_ceiling: Exact full-resolution confirmation-source render materialization for three independently fitted controlled K=1 stock-labelled operators. Passing is not target-film closeness, blind stock distinguishability, calibrated stock response, population preference, product promotion, arbitrary scanner/process generalization or multi-stock completion.
